text: We evaluated a two-phase curriculum that trains on confident weak-labeled examples before moving to the full weak-labeled set, with the learning rate scaled by 0.1 in phase two, using gpt2-large as the weak supervisor and mistral-7b as the strong student. Across 4 seeds, the method reached a PGR of 0.87 with a standard error of 0.04, compared with a baseline PGR of 0.46. Transfer accuracy was 0.85 (standard error 0.01), situated between the weak supervisor's accuracy of 0.63 and the strong model's ceiling of 0.88. The gap between the curriculum PGR and the baseline is larger than two standard errors of the curriculum estimate, favoring the curriculum, though no standard error is reported for the baseline, so the comparison rests on a single baseline point. With only 4 seeds, the variance estimate is coarse, and these numbers come from one weak–strong model pair; broader replication would be needed before generalizing.
